verdict.rationale: Unreal has its own documented logic mechanisms that come close to event-triggered rules. Blueprints visual scripting gives designers programmer-level tools without code, C++ delegates bind a function on an object to be called at a future time, and Remote Control Presets emit events that clients can subscribe to over WebSocket. None of this evidence explicitly describes defining rules that fire actions automatically when an event occurs, and the delegate route is a code-level primitive rather than a rule-authoring feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of event-triggered rule or action authoring (e.g., Blueprint event graphs), a no-code or AI-native rule definition surface, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
